recommendation: Keep this commit. It fixes concrete defects in the already-published source application without broadening the issue into new profile design; a collection-bundle profile should require an explicit work-group decision if the WG wants a type-fixing profile even though collection has no additional type-specific rules.
issue_request: FHIR-38943 was Published as Persuasive with Modification for R5. It requested standard informative profiles for Bundle types so the type-specific rules and restrictions could be expressed as profiles for downstream derivation rather than only as Bundle-page prose and constraints.
initial_application: HL7/fhir#2513, merged as cb9053fbfc160b5fd5af05d413a9251370a7e521, added the Bundle profile StructureDefinitions and Bundle-core ImplementationGuide. The final merged source still omitted message-bundle from the Bundle-core IG and left batch-bundle's Bundle.type pattern as the invalid code bundle.
additional_context: Bundle is active in source/fhir.ini and source/bundle/list-Bundle-packs.xml points to ImplementationGuide/Bundle-core, so the edited IG and profile files are current build inputs. FHIR-I minutes confirm the FHIR-38943 vote and later profile review request, and the Zulip/PR evidence confirms PR #2513 was intended to apply this issue. No later evidence found in this bounded search superseded the published decision.
reconciliation: Changed source/bundle/implementationguide-Bundle-core.xml to include StructureDefinition/message-bundle with the other Bundle profile resources, and changed source/bundle/structuredefinition-profile-batch-bundle.xml so batch-bundle constrains Bundle.type to batch.
source_changes: source/bundle/implementationguide-Bundle-core.xml: added the existing StructureDefinition/message-bundle resource reference to Bundle-core.
source/bundle/structuredefinition-profile-batch-bundle.xml: changed Bundle.type patternCode from bundle to batch.
